en: Coller-Dolittle Prize for Two-way Interspecies Communication
zh: Coller-Dolittle 双向跨物种交流奖
desc_en: Annual prize of the Jeremy Coller Foundation and Tel Aviv University, inspired by the Turing test, for research that deciphers or communicates with another species using its own signals; a grand prize awaits the first team to achieve two-way communication. Winners and finalists from 2025 on.
desc_zh: 由 Jeremy Coller Foundation 与特拉维夫大学设立、受图灵测试启发的年度奖项，奖励用其他物种自身的信号去破译它们或与之交流的研究；首个实现双向交流的团队将获得大奖。收录 2025 年以来的获奖与入围研究。
